# Generated plan conflict handling

`giwt rebase` and the rebase/squash paths of `giwt finalize` reconcile generated plan artifacts when a rebase stops on conflicts in the configured ticket index, code map, epics index, or feature matrix. With the default settings, these are `.plan/tickets/index.json`, `.plan/code-map.json`, `.plan/epics-index.md`, and `.plan/feature-matrix.md`.

**Tracking status (2026-11-11):** only the ticket index is tracked. The code map, epics index, and feature matrix are untracked — gitignored rebuildables, regenerated by `bun run plan:artifacts` (postinstall runs it on fresh clones; the pre-commit hook reruns it best-effort when `.plan/` or `src/` paths are staged). Untracked files cannot produce merge conflicts, so a rebase now stops only on conflicts in the tracked ticket index or in ordinary source files; the helper still regenerates the untracked artifacts from the reconciled plan sources but never stages them (its staging skips repo-ignored paths).

The ticket index is merged by record key and field: records and tags are unioned, and competing scalar fields keep the rebase-side value with a warning. The helper continues through successive rebase stops until the rebase completes or a non-generated conflict remains; if source files are also conflicted, the command stops and leaves the full conflict for manual resolution.

This is intentionally limited to generated plan artifacts; ordinary source conflicts remain manual.
